lawbenpina.heading: Lawbenpina Ventures
lawbenpina.paragraph: Lawbenpina Ventures is my own business, founded in 2017 and based in Accra. What started as a consulting and investment venture has grown into a trusted import service: if there is anything you want to bring in from China, Turkey, or elsewhere abroad, Lawbenpina Ventures will source it, arrange the logistics, and get it to you.
bullets: Sourcing and importing goods from China, Turkey, and other overseas markets
Consulting on business strategy, governance, and organisational development
Investment facilitation and strategic partnerships across sectors
lawbenpina.sideText: Send a screenshot of anything you want to import, no matter the product, to Lawbenpina Ventures on WhatsApp.

legaltree.heading: The Dr. Attakora Legal Tree
paragraphs: During my term as Vice President of the Law Students' Union at Kings University College, I sole-sponsored and built the Dr. Attakora Legal Tree, a digital resource hub named in honour of a respected member of the Faculty of Law. The Legal Tree was created to close the distance between students and the material they need most: past examination questions, core textbooks, law reports, and journal articles, all organised in one place and accessible to every student rather than only those with access to a well-stocked library.

Alongside the document library, the Legal Tree is to carry "Ask Attakora," a chatbot that is to let students put quick doctrinal questions to an AI assistant trained on the resources in the tree, so a student revising late at night is not left waiting until the next lecture for an answer. Together with the LSU website that I also funded and developed, the Legal Tree remains one of the initiatives from my time in student leadership that I am proudest of, because it outlived my term in office and continues to serve students who came after me.
